recognize_zh: 軸切面 PET 影像顯示前縱膈腔偏右、胸骨後方一個邊界清楚且強烈 FDG 攝取的腫塊（箭頭），代表高代謝的淋巴增生病灶，是切片取樣的目標。
features: Axial FDG-PET image at upper thoracic level (anterior at top, patient right on left)
Single intensely FDG-avid, well-circumscribed mass in the anterior/prevascular mediastinum (arrow)
Photopenic central dot artifact within the lesion
Low background uptake in lungs and chest wall; no additional avid focus on this slice
describe_en: Axial FDG-PET image of the upper chest demonstrates a solitary, intensely hypermetabolic, well-circumscribed mass in the anterior mediastinum (arrow), with low background activity in the lungs and chest wall. PET cannot establish histology; intense FDG avidity indicates a metabolically active lesion and helps direct biopsy and staging. In a transplant recipient, this finding supports an extranodal/mediastinal mass-forming lesion such as post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder, confirmed here on biopsy as plasmacytoma-like PTLD, EBV+.
